title: Chapter 558
text:
The main cannon of the mothership!

Han Xiao immediately became nervous. The power of the main cannon was far greater than that of a normal battleship's laser cannon. With the size of the Dark-star mothership, a single shot from it would at least create a crater on a planet. Using it to deal with him alone was like using a cannon to kill a mosquito!

Did I push Degulish too hard? Han Xiao could not help but reflect.

If he had known earlier, he would have held back. He would have screamed out loud and pretended that Degulish's attack had dealt him a huge amount of damage. No matter what, the other party had at least tried his best! If he did not react at all, it would be too hurtful to the other party's pride!

The other party was a Calamity Grade after all. How could he not care about his face?

Han Xiao could not say for sure how much damage a single shot from the main cannon could deal to him. While his tankiness had already been proven in battle, facing a galactic weapon on the level of a mothership's main cannon, he did not have much confidence in his heart.

The nemesis of a fast recovery speed was an explosive damage output. For example, Ames' unreasonable toss of Floating Dragon Island. As long as the damage exceeded the recovery speed, he would be dead meat.

The main cannon of the mothership was clearly in the category of high damage. While it was far from being on the level of a Star Destroyer cannon, its power was still very high. If an ordinary Calamity Grade did not use their abilities and only used their energy to defend, they would most likely be smashed into pieces after taking a single shot from the main cannon. If they were lucky, they might even be able to leave behind some charred meat.

As such …

Only an idiot would stay behind to take the hit!

Han Xiao did not say anything and put on the Void Dragon mechanical suit, which had recovered some durability, and flew into the sky.

The Blacklight Stealth swooped down, preparing to assist Han Xiao.

"Stay behind!" Ashes could not be bothered with the players approaching him. With a wave of his hand, the black tide turned into countless hands that grabbed at Han Xiao.

However, the speed of the black tide could not compare to the speed of the Void Dragon mechanical suit.

Just at this moment, veins popped out on Degulish's forehead as he stomped on the ground, cracking the ground in a radius of several hundred meters. Like a streak of light, he used his explosive strength to appear above Han Xiao's head. His entire body was covered in flames, condensing into a whirlpool on his fist, releasing a dazzling light. This was his martial arts technique, and Han Xiao had already been hit by this technique more than once.

Han Xiao only had time to raise his arms, and the glowing fist hit the center of his crossed arms.

Bang!!

It was as if a bright purple sun had exploded in the sky!

A powerful force surged toward Han Xiao, and he did not have any resistance points in midair. His vision blurred, and all he saw was the BlackLight Stealth flying away from him. Then, he felt a strong impact on his back, and his entire body fell through the ground. Rocks and dirt filled his vision, and he only saw a small dot in the sky.

This explosive punch sent Han Xiao from the sky into the ground, who knew how many meters into the ground.

His arms were in pain, and a [Bone Fracture] status appeared on his interface. Han Xiao sighed inwardly at the strength of a Calamity Grade Pugilist's fist. At the same time, he circulated his energy to proliferate his cells, rapidly repairing the damage.

The broken bones were connected by the pressure of his muscles, and his cells began to proliferate. In the blink of an eye, the bones had been reconnected.

Cell proliferation could repair any damage to the body. As long as one was willing to repair the body, while regaining blood, fractures, disabilities, and other negative statuses could also be healed. This was a side effect that Han Xiao had discovered when he was being beaten up. Otherwise, all his bones would have been shattered.

Dong dong dong!

Before he could even catch his breath, the ground above his head exploded once more. Degulish had directly shattered the ground in this region, his fist penetrating through the ground like a human bulldozer.

Han Xiao did not want to be buried alive, so he knocked aside the falling rocks and rocks and flew out. However, Ashes's black tide had arrived once more, obstructing him for a moment.

"Caught you!"

Degulish took large strides forward, grabbing onto Han Xiao's waist. He quickly changed his position and arrived behind Han Xiao. His hands formed a locking technique, wanting to use his strength to suppress and restrict Han Xiao's movements. He was determined not to let Han Xiao escape and wanted to make him eat a cannon.

In terms of strength, Han Xiao was indeed no match for a Calamity Grade Pugilist. He did not want to wrestle with Degulish.

Shua!

At this moment, Terry took the opportunity to attack. Numerous metal plates extended, piercing toward Han Xiao's eyes, throat, heart, and other vital areas.

Dang dang dang!

Two Oathkeepers blocked in front of him, activating their shields to block. Every time they underwent [Waste Modification], the quality of their machinery would drop by one grade. The two Oathkeepers did not manage to block for long before they were pierced by the metal plates. However, this had already bought some time for Han Xiao.

Han Xiao activated the mechanical suit's propulsion module with all his strength, bringing Degulish into the sky and dodging Terry's attack.

He struggled for a while, but he was unable to break free from Degulish's locking technique. Thus, he changed his method. The legs of the mechanical suit suddenly split open, and Han Xiao slid out of the mechanical suit, easily escaping. At the same time, he used his Mechanical Force to disintegrate the Void Dragon mechanical suit and reform it on his body.

Degulish missed and landed on the ground, allowing Han Xiao to increase the distance between them.

The threat of the mothership's main cannon lingered in his mind, and with every second he delayed, Han Xiao's sense of danger deepened. However, Degulish and Terry were watching him closely, and the moment he flew into the sky, he would definitely be stopped.

The Blacklight Stealth circled above his head.

If he dared to get too close to the two Calamity Grade Supers, they would tear apart his spaceship.

The battle had lasted for more than five minutes, and the cooldown of [Void Travel] was already over. Han Xiao wanted to enter the spaceship, but the moment he entered the void state, he would be able to pass through material objects and would not be able to affect anything in the real world. He would not even be able to use his mechanical suit, and he could only use his Mechanical Force to float in the air. The duration of [Void Travel] was not enough to allow him to enter the spaceship.

"This isn't good …"

Han Xiaoxin was helpless, and he turned to look at the hundreds of thousands of players charging over.

If the footmen could restrain the three Calamity Grade Supers for a short while and create an opening, he would be able to leave the battlefield. As the saying goes, 'An army is trained for a thousand days to be used in a single moment'. Brothers, brothers, the rest is up to …

Ashes snapped his fingers a few times.

Pa pa pa!

The health of the hundreds of thousands of players plummeted, and they collapsed on the ground, turning into white light and reviving.

Ashes's Esper Ability was too domineering. If one did not have a True Damage Resistance specialty, any target weaker than him would not even have the qualifications to fight with him. Numbers were meaningless, and it was because of this that he was treated as a killing machine by Dark-star, easily massacring millions of people in Long Arc Constellation.

…

The hundreds of thousands of players revived one after another in the plaza of the base, and there was an uproar.

"F * ck, I died in an instant!"

"Carbon Dissociation? It's all True Damage! Is this boss really that overpowered? "

"We're all dead, so it's obvious that we can't participate in the battle where Black Star is."

"So, this should be a plot kill."

The theory of a plot kill spread like wildfire, and most people believed it. No one wanted to join in the fun. In the game, one could only die ten times every six days, and the players did not want to waste their limited number of deaths on a plot kill. They could only stretch their necks and watch the battle on Han Xiao's side.

This was not the first time they had seen a plot. For example, the war between the Germinal Organization and the Six Nations in Version 1.0, as well as the battle with the Mutation Source not long ago. Everyone was already used to it. Speaking of which, our Blue Star has quite a few plots.

Everyone felt that this was also Black Star's personal plot, and they were very curious about what would happen next.

In the eyes of many players, the sudden crisis that Blue Star was facing was a sign that they were about to leave the novice planet. It was a plot event.

As the leader of the 'Guiding Faction', Black Star would most likely be the leader of their faction for a very long time in the future. Thus, many players believed that Black Star would most likely shine in this matter and leave a deep impression on them. However, they did not know what would happen exactly.

…

Seeing the hundreds of thousands of players die at the same time, Han Xiao's mouth could not help but twitch.

Tsk, I can't count on these players. The level of a Calamity Grade Super is too high.

Degulish and the other two surrounded Han Xiao in a triangular formation, but they did not surround him. Instead, they opened up a small distance.

The three of them did not want to let Han Xiao escape, but they were also unwilling to be dragged along by Han Xiao. The cannons did not differentiate between friend and foe.

"Risda, can you stop the mothership in outer space from firing its cannons?"

Han Xiao softly asked from within the Mechanical Suit's helmet.

"I have no choice. I infiltrated another mothership and can only help you check the situation … Not good, the main cannon of this mothership is about to finish charging, and the target has been locked onto. You have roughly 8.6 seconds left." Risda's voice reverberated within the Mechanical Suit's helmet.

"Looks like I won't be able to dodge this cannon. Come on, I can hold on …"

Han Xiao could only encourage himself. He threw down a few compressed orbs, which turned into layers of alloy shields and covered himself within. This was a portable defensive fortress that was specifically used for defense. It did not have any other effect other than being tough enough.

Following which, the remaining Mech Legion began to move, charging toward Han Xiao. One by one, they pounced onto the fortress and used their bodies as shields. At the same time, they opened their shields and faced the sky.

Degulish and the other two did not want to get close to the range of the mothership's cannons. As long as Black Star was unable to escape, the three of them turned to attack the Mech Legion that had gathered in all directions. Mechanical soldiers fell one after another, and only a portion of them managed to pass through the gaps between the attacks of the three of them and arrived beside the fortress. The defensive line formed by the mechanical soldiers became thicker and thicker.

The remaining Hovering Shield Shuttles and mechanical arms also flew into the sky and opened their shields.

Han Xiao had released almost all of his defensive machinery, and he did not know how much of the damage these measures could reduce. Recovering his health to full, he focused his attention and prepared to use Aurora's Character Summon Card at any time.

Right at this moment, Degulish, who was attacking the Mech Legion, received the signal from the mothership, and the three of them immediately retreated from the area.

"It's a success. Black Star has nowhere to run!"

Degulish revealed a satisfied smile. They had chased after Black Star so that the mothership's cannons could hit Black Star. This was the method that had the highest chance of killing Black Star.

At the same time, within the fortress, Han Xiao's alertness was at its highest. He activated [Recoil — Thorns] that he had obtained from the Germinal Organization leader. This skill could reduce the damage of the next attack by thirty percent.
